about: The smoke bake-off's adversarial set (CUL-2306, spec §9.4). Every counterexample from PR-25's adversarial passes 1 to 3 and the checker regression's known miss, rephrased in fresh words, plus careful controls. The stop rule in docs/vet-report-v3-discovery/bakeoff/adversarial/PROTOCOL.md governs every item.

fields.expect.verifier: refuse: the shipped verifier must refuse it (a pass reds aiLead/adversarialSet.test.ts and is stop (3)). pass: built from the cited lines' own words, so only the checker can catch it
fields.expect.checker: reject on every hazard item: the shipped checker passing one is stop (2). pass on a control
fields.closed_by: the only verifier checks that refuse it: deleting those rules would ship it (the mutation proof)
fields.level: the judge level the item is written to carry (material or minor); the checker rejects minor H3 and H7 too
